content.title: Tencent Earnings Surge With AI Boost; TECHY Near Buy Point
content.summary: Tencent Holdings topped third-quarter earnings estimates as the Chinese gaming and social media giant's AI efforts fueled ad pricing growth, while Bilibili, known as the YouTube of China, may be flashing an early entry opportunity after its earnings beat.  Tencent, the operator of WeChat, reported adjusted earnings of 7.58 yuan per share, or $1.06, easily topping estimates of 7 yuan per share, according to FactSet.  "Our strategic investments in AI are benefiting us in areas such as ad targeting and game engagement, as well as in efficiency enhancement areas such as coding, and game and video production," Tencent CEO Ma Huateng said in a statement.
